verdict.rationale: Typesense documents Natural Language Search and 'built-in retrieval-augmented generation (RAG)' plus LLM integrations that let queries be interpreted and answered conversationally, which can surface AI-derived insights from indexed data, but this is a developer-facing API capability requiring integration, not a built-in insights/suggestions UI for end users inside the product. missing for 10: evidence of an out-of-the-box insights/suggestions UI or dashboard, first-party product screenshots of RAG-generated insights in use, independent user reports validating the RAG/NLS features work as advertised.
